desc: Implement DSU (union-find) with path compression over indices of values <= threshold, plus a value->index map; count values > threshold as isolated.
For each g in 1..threshold, gather present multiples of g via sieve-style loop over the value map.
Rewrite pair enumeration with the optimized gcd-free version: for each g's sorted list, union pairs (a,b) with a*b <= g*threshold using early break.
Compute answer = (# values > threshold) + (# distinct DSU roots among small values).
Test with provided examples and edge cases: single element, value equal to threshold, all isolated, non-divisibility lcm edge (6 and 10, t=30 vs t=29), threshold=1, large-n performance sanity check.
